## Prepare in advance

You can prepare with the shared materials now. They do not depend on the edition.

- Read the required text: Bender et al., [On the Dangers of Stochastic Parrots](https://doi.org/10.1145/3442188.3445922) [-@bender2021].
- Look at the [syllabus](../syllabus.qmd) and the four lens pages.
- Read the [assignments](../assignments.qmd) page.

## Follow-up task and deadline

The deadline for the follow-up task is {{< edition fs2027 assessment_deadline >}}. The [assignments](../assignments.qmd) page describes the task.

## Contact

Ask the Graduate Center (GRACE) of the University of Basel about the next edition. Report errors on this site through [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/maehr/stochastic-parrots-and-beyond/issues).
